    if not 0 <= number < len(alphabet):

def find_roots(graph: "Graph", prop: "URIRef", roots: Optional[Set["Node"]] = None) -> Set["Node"]:
    graph = graph
    prop = prop
    roots = set() if roots is None else roots
    # Initialize the stack with nodes with the target property
    stack = [node for node in graph if graph.predecessors(node) == [prop]]
    while stack:
        node = stack.pop()
        roots.add(node)
        # Add all predecessors of the current node to the stack
        stack.extend(graph.predecessors(node))
    return roots
